build_rocbert_masked_lm: build a RoCBert masked language model for bidirectional token prediction with shape and pronunciation embeddings
create_rocbert_causal_lm: create a RoCBert causal language model for autoregressive generation with past key value caching
test_rocbert_sequence_classification: test the RoCBert sequence classification model for GLUE-style tasks with pooled output classifier
run_rocbert_question_answering: run RoCBert question answering model to predict start and end token positions for span extraction
